response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS a FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM t), k AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.a FROM t CROSS JOIN b1 WHERE t.a > b1.v), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM k), f AS (SELECT k.telescref, k.a FROM k CROSS JOIN b2 WHERE k.a > b2.v) SELECT AVG(f.a) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(f.a - b1.v) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline, AVG(f.a - b2.v) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline FROM f CROSS JOIN b1 CROSS JOIN b2
